answer: Edges in the trust graph decay: an attestation loses half its weight every two epochs unless the pair does fresh work together. Replay a submission and the edge is clawed back to zero, and no identity may audit its own recruit. Across 4,000 edges last month the decay cut stale vouches by 61%, and a farm on an island subnet could not keep its ivory tower of mutual attestations alive through one karst slide of inactivity.
